section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the procedure for a study conducted in Brazil on body image. Participants were recruited through opportunistic sampling at various campus locations and completed anonymous paper-and-pencil questionnaires at a quiet campus location. The study involved six experimenters, voluntary participation, and verbal debriefing after questionnaire completion.
